description_en: Intelligently adjusts image dimensions, supporting multiple methods such as automatic cropping and padding
description_zh: 智能调节图像尺寸，支持自动裁剪、补全等多种方案
name: ChangeImageSize

parameters.help_en: The target width. Unit: pixels. Valid values: 10 to 5000
parameters.help_zh: 目标宽度，单位：像素，取值范围[10, 5000]
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: The target height. Unit: pixels. Valid values: 10 to 5000
parameters.help_zh: 目标高度，单位：像素，取值范围[10, 5000]
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length
parameters.help_zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K
parameters.name: url

Data.description_en: The response data. For specific fields, see the structure definition
Data.description_zh: 响应的数据，具体字段请查看结构定义

Url.description_en: The URL of the output image after resizing. Note: <font color=red>The URL is valid for 72 hours</font>
Url.description_zh: 图片URL，尺寸变换后的输出图片地址，注意 <font color=red>有效期是72小时</font>

Message.description_en: The error message. If Code is not "0", check this field for the specific error information
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，code非“0”的情况下具体错误信息请查看本字段

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud system
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云系统自动生成
